title: Create a Git Worktree for a Branch
trigger: User opens a git repository in a new cluster and wants a separate working directory for the branch

steps.action: After opening a git repository in a cluster, a dialog appears asking Work in a separate worktree?
The Worktree name field shows a suggested name (based on the project name), already selected
Accept the suggestion by pressing Enter or modify the name if needed; the dialog validates that it is a usable folder name and not already in use
The worktree is created; the cluster's File Explorer roots at the worktree's folder, and terminals open there
The source control panel now shows changes relative to the worktree's branch, with committed and uncommitted work together

outcome: A new worktree is created with its own folder and branch, isolated from other work on the same repository
